jobs.description: Warehouse Employee As a Warehouse Employee, you ensure that orders leave the warehouse on time, complete, and correct. The scanner will guide you flawlessly through the warehouse, and it will be your job to stack everything accurately and securely onto pallets that can sometimes be up to 2.2 meters high. Physical work does not deter you: bags weighing up to 25 kilos are no problem for you, and you understand the importance of safe and correct lifting. You will usually work independently, but you will help out when colleagues need assistance. Do you see room for improvement in the process?
